content_sections.heading: Redhakhol Forest Division Computer/ Data Science Expert Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on the academic qualifications with preference to experience and performance in the interview. Candidate having similar work experience/ knowledge of working in Forest Department will be given preference. Candidates should bring true copies of testimonials of educational qualifications, certification, work experience, proof for date of birth, etc., along with copies of mark sheets of all examinations along with the original documents for verification to Divisional Forest Office, Redhakhol Forest Division, Redhakhol on the date of interview. Original and self-attested photocopy of the Community Certificate in case person claiming age relaxation. A brief write upon previous experience should also be submitted along with the resume. After scrutiny of the application, the eligible candidates shall be called for the interview. The date and venue shall be notified to the shortlisted candidates separately through email.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 12-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Redhakhol Forest Division to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Computer/ Data Science Expert post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Computer/ Data Science Expert position at Redhakhol Forest Division is 12 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have a B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering, IT, Data Science or related fields, or a Postgraduate degree in Computer Science & Engineering or related fields from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Computer/ Data Science Expert position?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as of 01.01.2026. Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST/SEBC candidates.

faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 36,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How will the candidates be selected for this post?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on academic qualifications, with preference given to relevant work experience and performance in the interview.

faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.answer: Applications must be submitted strictly through the online mode via the provided link or the official website.
